_comment: Chain grounding job (change: chain-grounding). `remote` is polled with git ls-remote; it redirects to RaoFoundation/subtensor, the repotrack clone's remote, with the same tag SHAs (checked 2026-11-27). Every claude run passes --model from tools/claude-model.json: --restricted ignores the user settings files, so a model set there never applies (found 2026-11-27, when runs fell back to the account default). Section budgets are bytes of rendered Markdown; the whole GROUNDING.md must stay under max_bytes. `chain_exclude` are plain SubtensorModule values that are running state, not parameters. `dynamic` items move with chain activity, so DIFF.md reports how many subnets changed, not each value.

sections.title: Emission
sections.scope: Subnet emission shares and how they are computed, any gate, bar or threshold that decides which subnets emit, TAO pool injection versus chain buys, miner_burned and how the subnet owner cut is handled.

sections.title: Yuma consensus, weights, bonds and dividends
sections.scope: The epoch: weights, consensus, trust and incentive, bonds and their moving average, liquid alpha, Yuma3, commit-reveal, and how a subnet's emission splits between miners, validators and owner.

sections.title: dTAO pools, swaps, fees, slippage
sections.scope: Subnet pools (TAO and alpha reserves), the swap and its price, fees, slippage limits, and how prices and moving prices are kept.

sections.title: Staking
sections.scope: Root stake and alpha stake, childkeys and their takes and cooldowns, delegate takes, stake weight, locks and conviction, unstaking and any unlock or maturity rates.

sections.title: Registration, immunity and pruning
sections.scope: Subnet registration and its lock cost, neuron registration burn and how it adjusts, immunity periods, neuron pruning, and subnet deregistration or dissolution.

sections.title: Key hyperparameter defaults
sections.scope: Code defaults of the per-subnet and chain-wide hyperparameters most used in practice. Each claim names one storage item and its default.

sections.title: Coldkey swap and other safety delays
sections.scope: Coldkey swap announcement and delays, and other rate limits or delays that protect accounts or subnets.

sections.title: Deprecated / common traps
sections.scope: Mechanisms that older docs or model training data still describe as current. Each claim says what no longer applies, what applies now, and cites the current code.

sections.title: Changelog of live spec bumps
sections.scope: Generated from git history and observed upgrades. No model.
